text:
Skerrow Bank wind farm entered full operation on 14 March 2025, the day its final turbine was commissioned, and I was on the quayside to watch it happen.

The farm has 34 turbines. Dr. Imelda Varga-Thorne, Chief Project Engineer at Halvorsen Tidewater Energy, confirmed the count to me at the commissioning ceremony. "Thirty-four turbines, every one of them online," she said.

Each turbine is rated at 12 MW, giving the farm a total installed capacity of 408 MW.

The Northern Marches Offshore Energy Authority issued the Skerrow Bank Commissioning Certificate, Ref. SB-2025-0314, which was presented during the ceremony. I saw the document myself as it was handed over.

With the last turbine now commissioned, the farm is operating at its full installed capacity.
